Imagine you are standing in a long line and want to know how many people are in front of you. Instead of counting them all yourself, you ask the person directly in front of you how many people are in front of them, and they do the exact same thing. This chain of asking continues until it reaches the person at the very front, who simply answers "zero" and passes that number back. Each person then adds one to the number they received and passes it back down the line until the final total reaches you.
